title: Six Seats Among the Stars
synopsis: Rex finds his fitted seat in the cabin trainer. All six travelers practice restraint, communications, and properly stored supplies.
continuity_state: Before: The assembled rocket is on the pad; Max, Aunt Jo, Rex, Gus, Jack, and Molly have not yet finished cabin and suit familiarization. After: Six fitted seats, cabin supplies, helmets, radios and adult duties have been rehearsed; no flight has begun.
